zones.name: Arrabbiata 2 variable right
zones.basis: Guide describes Arrabbiata 2 as spectacular with variable height and angle; public guide also frames the Casanova/Savelli/Arrabbiata sequence as a rollercoaster.

zones.name: Scarperia tight right
zones.basis: Guide describes Scarperia as a very tight corner requiring fast speed reduction; shaping is kept mild.

zones.name: Palagio left exit
zones.basis: Guide describes Palagio as the gate to the final straight; shaping is only a light left-corner support.

zones.name: Correntaio downhill right
zones.basis: Guide describes Correntaio as a downhill hairpin leading toward the very fast Biondetti section.

zones.name: Biondetti left entry
zones.basis: Guide describes the Biondetti section as very fast; the left entry receives mild support.

zones.name: Biondetti right exit
zones.basis: Guide describes the Biondetti section as very fast; the right exit receives mild support.

zones.name: Bucine long left
zones.basis: Guide describes Bucine as the longest curve and the final challenge before the straight.

zones.name: San Donato tight right
zones.basis: Guide describes San Donato as the tight first bend and the slowest point; shaping is conservative.

zones.name: Luco left opener
zones.basis: Guide describes Luco as a left corner that rounds off into a long set of bends.

zones.name: Poggio Secco high right
zones.basis: Guide identifies Poggio Secco as the highest point before the descent toward Materassi.

zones.name: Materassi left
zones.basis: Guide groups Materassi/Borgo San Lorenzo as an engaging entry with fast exit.

zones.name: Borgo San Lorenzo right
zones.basis: Guide groups Materassi/Borgo San Lorenzo as more open than Luco with a fast exit.

zones.name: Casanova right drop
zones.basis: Public guide highlights the Casanova/Savelli/Arrabbiata sequence as stomach-churning and rollercoaster-like.

zones.name: Savelli left drop
zones.basis: Public guide highlights the Casanova/Savelli/Arrabbiata sequence as stomach-churning and rollercoaster-like.

zones.name: Arrabbiata 1 low right
zones.basis: Guide describes Arrabbiata 1 as the lowest point and part of the spectacular rollercoaster sequence.
